name: 16310-solodecode-glm45airfp8-dp4
model: zai-org/GLM-4.5-Air-FP8, target and draft: the checkpoint ships its own next-token-prediction layer (`num_nextn_predict_layers: 1`), so the draft path is the same repository and there is no second download.
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, no router and no external cache tier.
parallelism: Four ranks. `tp-size 4` is the world size and `dp-size 4` splits attention inside it, so attn_tp_size is 1: each rank runs the whole attention over its own slice of the batch and the MoE is tensor-parallel across all four.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup the first 10%, bounded at 200 requests with a 3600 s safety cap. One stream is part of the declaration and not a starting guess: it may be confirmed, but not walked upward.
workload: GSM8K five-shot, text completions: 200 prompts from `configs/data/gsm8k-5shot-200.jsonl`, ~750 tokens each over a ~600-token preamble shared by all of them, generations capped at 512 tokens, temperature 0, stop `[Question, Assistant:, <|separator|>]`, `ignore_eos` unset so output length is a distribution.
purpose: A single-user grade-school math solver with built-in draft decoding, running shared-preamble few-shot prompts on four GPUs.
launch:
# ENGINE: sglang at the commit named by configs/setupcard.md `commit_id`.
#
# Flat `key: value` only -- a nested block is DROPPED by the flat parser and the engine would then
# run without something this file declares. host/port/served-model-name are owned by the serving
# layer; configs/tuned.yaml carries the one environment variable this setup needs.

model-path: zai-org/GLM-4.5-Air-FP8

tp-size: 4
dp-size: 4
enable-dp-attention: true

# The draft is the SAME repository: the checkpoint ships its own next-token-prediction layer.
# A chain, not a tree -- topk 1, three draft steps, four verified positions, and these move
# together. topk must be 1: the overlap speculative worker refuses anything larger at this commit.
speculative-algorithm: EAGLE
speculative-draft-model-path: zai-org/GLM-4.5-Air-FP8
speculative-num-steps: 3
speculative-eagle-topk: 1
speculative-num-draft-tokens: 4

# Declared rather than left to auto-selection, and not interchangeable: the draft's own multi-step
# backend is built from this choice.
attention-backend: fa3

context-length: 4096
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
random-seed: 16274
